description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Layout' that serves as the main page layout for a web application. It includes a sticky navbar with navigation links, a main content area where nested routes render via <Outlet />, and a footer with links. The component also incorporates other components like ContactCtas and FloatingContactCtas for contact call-to-actions.

methods.name: Layout()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the site layout with header, main, footer, and additional components.
